text:
sam.k: Heads up — I'm oncall tonight. I'm going to do a short routing/threshold tweak to cut down noise from our nightly batch jobs (02:00–04:00 PT). Routing non-urgent mem alerts to a digest channel and bumping threshold for pool 'batch-gpu'. I'll post exact cmds and PD rule after I apply.

olivia.h: Thanks — what's the exact change? Want me to be on standby?

sam.k: Plan: increase mem.high_percent alert from 85 -> 95 for nodes with label pool=batch-gpu between 02:00-05:00 (we'll keep a small buffer). Also map severity=warning to eng-oncall-digest (no page) and keep severity=critical as normal page. Applying in ~10m, will add auto-revert and an audit note.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please add a rollback note to ticket when changing routing.

sam.k: Command I'm using (sanitized):
```
# temporarily update alert rule
curl -X POST https://monitoring.internal/api/alerts/update \
  -d '{"rule":"mem_high","selector":"pool=batch-gpu","threshold":95,"window":"5m","mute_window":"02:00-05:00"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MONITORING_TOKEN"
# PD routing (example)
pd-cli rules create --name "batch-gpu-digest" --route "eng-oncall-digest" --match "source=batch-gpu and severity=warning" --no-page
```

jasonm: Can you add a check for KV cache evictions? Last time we bumped thresholds it masked a real OOM pattern (eviction spikes).

sam.k: Good catch — adding an anomaly check: if eviction_rate > 50/min for any batch-gpu node, escalate to critical regardless of mem threshold. I'll push that small alert now.

olivia.h: I'll be on standby 02:00-04:00 PT in case you want to revert quickly.

sam.k: Applied change at 01:52 PT. Ticket INF-2891 (temp routing + thresholds). Revert scheduled at 05:15 PT by the auto-revert job unless we extend. Ping in thread to extend. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Change recorded. Audit ID: a1b2c3. Auto-revert scheduled at 05:15 PT.

sre_lead: Thanks Sam — quick ask: can we add a one-line doc to the oncall wiki describing this workflow and the PD rule name so future oncallers know to look for INF-2891? I can draft it.

sam.k: Will add a short note and link it here. If anyone sees unexpected pages between 02:00-05:00 PLZ call out in this thread before escalating config changes.
